Media player supported features can change dynamically (not allowed, grandfathered in) so we can't assume the state only represents values that it can reproduce.

This PR adds supported feature checks to reproduce state.

issue_context.title: LG webostv unable to restore state in scene when sound_output is external_arc
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Hi,

I just upgraded from 2021.12.8 to 2022.4.1 which made the webostv integration forgot my old tv and detected it as a new device. Not a huge problem by itself, I just reconfigured my existing automations and scenes for the new device using the UI. After trying to activate a scene though, it activates only partially and produces this error on the UI (full stack trace is attached below):

```homeassistant.exceptions.HomeAssistantError: Entity media_player.lg_webos_tv_oled55b9pla does not support this service.```

After some testing I found out this error is triggered when the tv has sound_output set to **external_arc** at the time when the scene is activated. It does not trigger when sound_output is **tv_speaker**. Changing TV input and other controls in the UI seem to work regardless of sound_output state.

I only use ARC so this effectively breaks all my scenes using the tv. All my scenes have been configured from the UI and I also made a simple example scene which is included below.

Slightly related issue: sound output does not get changed back to external_arc even though it's recorded on the scene definition, though I'm not sure if that has ever been the case since I have never even tried it before today.


### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2022.4.1

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

core-2012.12.8

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Container

### Integration causing the issue

webostv

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/webostv

### Diagnostics information

_No response_
